# Create Single Module from Command Line

A very simple application that defines a main method and configures the manifest
accordingly using only the tools that come with Java (without using build tools
such as [Maven](https://maven.apache.org/) or [Gradle](https://gradle.org/)).

## Prerequisites

- [Oracle Java 25](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/#java25)

## Run the example

1. (*Optional*) Clean the `target` directory

   ```shell
   rm -rf './target'
   ```

2. (*Optional*) List the source files

   ```shell
   tree --dirsfirst --sort=name './src/'
   ```

   The source files

   ```
   ./src/
   └── main
       └── java
           ├── demo
           │   └── Main.java
           └── module-info.java

   4 directories, 2 files
   ```

3. Compile the application

   ```shell
   javac \
     --source-path './src/main/java' \
     -d './target/classes' \
     './src/main/java/demo/Main.java'
   ```

   (*Optional*) List the classes

   ```shell
   tree --dirsfirst --sort=name './target/classes'
   ```

   The application class files

   ```
   ./target/classes
   ├── demo
   │   └── Main.class
   └── module-info.class

   2 directories, 2 files
   ```

4. Create the JAR file

   Create the directory where the JAR file will be created.

   ```shell
   mkdir -p './target/libs'
   ```

   Create the JAR file

   ```shell
   jar --create \
     --verbose \
     --file './target/libs/create-single-module-from-command-line.jar' \
     --main-class demo.Main \
     -C './target/classes' module-info.class \
     -C './target/classes' demo
   ```

   (*Optional*) Verify that the JAR file was created

   ```shell
   tree --sort=name './target/libs'
   ```

   The application JAR file

   ```
   ./target/libs
   └── create-single-module-from-command-line.jar

   1 directory, 1 file
   ```

   (*Optional*) List the JAR file contents

   ```shell
   jar --list --verbose --file './target/libs/create-single-module-from-command-line.jar'
   ```

   The application JAR file contents

   ```
        0 Tue Apr 27 12:34:56 +01:00 2077 META-INF/
       91 Tue Apr 27 12:34:56 +01:00 2077 META-INF/MANIFEST.MF
      225 Tue Apr 27 12:34:56 +01:00 2077 module-info.class
        0 Tue Apr 27 12:34:56 +01:00 2077 demo/
      965 Tue Apr 27 12:34:56 +01:00 2077 demo/Main.class
   ```

5. Describe the JAR file

   ```shell
   jar --describe-module --file './target/libs/create-single-module-from-command-line.jar'
   ```

   The JAR file/module description

   ```
   demo jar:file:///./target/libs/create-single-module-from-command-line.jar!/module-info.class
   requires java.base mandated
   contains demo
   main-class demo.Main
   ```

   Note that the module’s main class is defined, thus we can run the application
   without providing the main class canonical path.

   The main class is defined in the `META-INF/MANIFEST.MF` file that was created
   by maven.

   ```shell
   unzip -p './target/libs/create-single-module-from-command-line.jar' 'META-INF/MANIFEST.MF'
   ```

   This will print the contents of the manifest file

   ```
   Manifest-Version: 1.0
   Created-By: 25.0.4.1 (Oracle Corporation)
   Main-Class: demo.Main
   ```

6. Run the application

   ```shell
   java --module-path './target/libs' --module demo
   ```

   The application will run and prints

   ```
   Create Single Module from Command Line
   Using Java 25.0.4.1
   ```
